description: Empirically measured sustained throughput and bandwidth on the GH200 campaign device, copied verbatim from the frozen TileArena calibration profile (not an NVIDIA datasheet value). Used as the GH200 P_emp / BW_emp of the empirical SOL T_SOL = max(F / P_emp[mode], Q / BW_emp).

notes: value is the exact number stored in the frozen profile (unit as stored: byte/s, FLOP/s, OP/s); value_scaled = value / 1e9 (GB/s) or value / 1e12 (TFLOP/s, TOP/s) for readability only.

mma_int8_i32acc is an integer rate in OP/s (TOP/s scaled), not FLOP/s. Its value is the layout-corrected measurement (A row-major x B column-major, cutlass i16832 tensor-op tn kernel, torch._int_mm). The original row x row probe of GH200-20261007T203829Z-a2fe6ae1 (132.52 TOP/s) is a layout artifact, superseded and not used; both layout variants remain in the frozen profile as valid points.
Modes listed under modes_not_calibrated were not measured in this calibration (not in the run's mode list); they have no value and are unavailable for GH200, never estimated.
gemm_fp32_ieee has role 'control': a library SGEMM comparison value, never a scoring ceiling.
flags and limitations are copied from the profile; 'saturation_not_demonstrated' means the best point was the largest measured shape.
This file is a data-only copy; the scoring path reads the frozen profile through manifests/calibration.yaml, not this file.
